title: Code marks
description: A highlight of part of the code: whole lines, or only some characters within them. Used by journey steps and beats (docs/journey-format.md, "Marks") and podcast segments (docs/podcast-format.md, "Marks").
$comment: Rules from src/core/format/marks.ts markShapeProblem and journey.py mark_shape_problem (the two agree). Not expressible here: lines[0] <= lines[1]. Left out on purpose (warnings only): more than 3 marks per step or beat, a match nobody's text names, a match equal to the whole line, a mark outside the step's lines. Checks against the code (the file exists, the lines exist, match is found) need the repository and are not part of the file's shape.

file.description: A file path relative to the repository.

lines.description: [first, last]: 1-based line numbers, inclusive, first <= last.

match.description: Only this text within the lines lights, written exactly as in the code; it may span lines.

nth.description: Which occurrence of match within the lines lights (1-based; default 1).

mark.description: One mark: lines of a file, or only the text `match` within them.

file.description: The file, relative to the repository. Default: the owner's file (the step's, the beat's code file, or the podcast segment's).

lines.description: The lines it covers: [first, last], 1-based, inclusive.

match.description: Only this text within the lines lights; without it, the whole lines do.

nth.description: Which occurrence of match within the lines (1-based; default 1).

marks.description: A list of marks, lit in order.
